Name: Person ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the person record. Only available when updating existing people.

Name: Person Number
Description: A number to uniquely identify the person. If you have configured person numbers to be automatically generated, this leave blank.

Name: Effective End Date
Description: Leave blank.

Name: Effective Start Date
Description: The hire date of the worker. Date-tracked updates are not supported, to correct existing attribute values supply the worker's hire date.

Name: Action Code
Description: The action being performed, for example, 'HIRE'.

Name: Blood type
Description: The person's blood type.

Name: Correspondence Language
Description: The person's correspondence language.

Name: Country of Birth
Description: The person's country of birth.

Name: Date of Birth
Description: The person's date of birth.

Name: Date of Death
Description: The person's date of death.

Name: Duplicate Person Record Check
Description: Determines whether checking for duplicate person records is enabled and the attributes that are used to identify duplicate records.

Name: Reason Code
Description: The reason for the action being performed on the record.

Name: Region of Birth
Description: The person's region of birth. If the country of birth is France the region of birth is validated against the list of departments that exist in the geography hierarchy for France.

Name: Start Date
Description: The hire date of the worker.

Name: Town of Birth
Description: The person's town of birth.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Name: Reference 1
Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application. You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
